correctness.rationale: Conditional on a fixed point at t in a four-window, the remaining ranks are counted by binomial(t-1,r-1)binomial(n-t,4-r)/(n-1)_3. Off-window indicators contribute no covariance. Vandermonde on the rth order statistic gives Cov(F,N_tau)=1/(2n)-E_tau/[n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)], with E_tau only the at-most-six missing boundary positions. R_tau=3(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)-6E_tau has degree at most three. For each of all 24 patterns, exact evaluation at n=4,5,6,7 proves the displayed cubic identity (n-3)Q_tau=R_tau for every n>=4; explicit quadratic signs give the three and only three reversals. Independently recomputed exact boundary identities for all patterns and small-n direct permutation moments. This is an all-n polynomial proof, not an extrapolation from samples.
